name: hilbish.processors
description:
The processors interface manages command processors, which are functions that
can transform a command string before it is executed. Processors run in order
of priority, lowest number first.

docs.name: add
description: Registers a command processor. A processor is a table with at minimum a
`name` and a `func` field. The `func` receives the command string and may
return a table with any of: `command` (the new command string), `continue`
(whether to abort execution if false), and [`modifiers`](../features/modifiers).

params.Name: processor
Doc: A table with `name` (string), `func` (function), and optional `priority` (number, default 0).

docs.name: execute
description: Runs all registered processors against the provided command in priority order.

Keys.Name: skip
Doc: A list of processor names to skip.

returns.Name: result
Doc: The (possibly modified) result of running the processors.

Keys.Name: modifiers
Doc: Any modifier flags set by processors.
